intro: Across nine articles spanning 16 April 2026 to 1 October 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of Cisco centers on critical-severity vulnerabilities and the actors exploiting them. Interlock and The Gentlemen feature among the tracked threat actors. The most severe flaws carry CVSS 10 ratings: CVE-2026-20079, CVE-2026-20127, and CVE-2026-20182. CVE-2026-76504 rates CVSS 9.8, while CVE-2022-20653 also appears. Six issues are rated critical and two high. Affected sectors include enterprise networking, government, telecommunications, critical infrastructure, and the federal civilian executive branch. Impacts reach the United States, Global, North America, Turkey, and the UK.
